body:
# Yemen, Riyadh and Hormuz, Nov 23 to 25

| Event | What the source says | State |
|---|---|---|
| **Hodeidah, early Wed 11/25 local** | coalition statement: 'targeted operational capabilities' at Hodeidah, destroyed targets in Saada and Amran (Reuters, Tolba, 03:26Z 11/25 via Yahoo); Al Jazeera headline: coalition says it bombed the port, 'early morning hours on Wednesday' | COALITION-CONFIRMED; damage and port status NOT STATED |
| **Houthi threat, before that strike** | Saree: Jeddah and all other Saudi Red Sea ports would be targeted **if** Saudi Arabia carried out its threats against Hodeidah; port workers to leave, ships to withdraw (Reuters). Coalition strikes came 'after the Houthi statement' | conditional when made; **condition now met**. No clock times |
| Riyadh tower, Tue 11/24 | coalition (al-Maliki): drone attack on King Abdullah Financial District; civil defence: **11 wounded** (2 Saudi, 2 Indian, 3 Nepali, 4 Egyptian). AFP witnesses name the PIF tower; coalition did not name it. Second hit in six days (card 20261119-003) | STRUCK, state-confirmed; no Houthi claim found |
| Sanaa, late Tue | strikes near the airport (al-Masirah via Xinhua 22:12Z); Houthi count of 72 strikes in 24 hours | CLAIM-ONLY |
| Attack on Jeddah, Yanbu, Jazan or another Saudi port after the strike | none found by my search at 22:40 ET | NOT FOUND, not disproof |
| Hormuz ships | UKMTO: three vessels hit by unidentified projectiles sailing east, all continued, crews accounted for (Reuters 11/24) | **event date conflict**: 'Monday' (Reuters) vs about 20:25 UTC Nov 22, time-late (Arab Times, search summary). Guard ADD#26: do not merge |
| IRGC tankers on mines; container ship on a mine | Iranian navy and IRGC via Tasnim and state media | CLAIM-ONLY; no maritime authority confirmation found; CENTCOM called earlier mine claims false. GATE 2 untouched |
| Transits | Marine Traffic: 226 vessels Nov 1 to 7, 125 Nov 17 to 23 (Al Jazeera) | AIS FLOOR, not a level |
| Oil | Brent January settled $91.40 (+2.27%), low $88.10; WTI $82.05 (The Nation Thailand). Vendor BZF27 90.25 at 22:20 ET | settle secondhand |

- **Date trap:** Alhurra's page with maps of Yanbu, Jazan, King Fahd Industrial Port and Jeddah is **Nov 20**, the first round (cards 022, 025). One search summary merges it with Nov 25. The second round repeats the first: threat, then strike. After the Nov 20 round no hit on a Saudi Red Sea port was confirmed by Nov 23 or 24.
- **'Trump postponed strikes to next year'** (Engine 11/24, no quote) traces to Axios on Thu Nov 19, per one secondary: 'I am not rushing into any decision... We will see what happens after the beginning of the year.' The quote is not a dated postponement.
- **Iran page:** last full sweep 11/23 21:33Z; this card is a partial touch, not a full sweep. No US strike, CENTCOM statement, Aramco, Mawani or carrier statement read tonight.
- **Owners:** FALCON grades the ladder and census; BRENT the bypass watch, due Wednesday 11/25. If either port is hit, the bypass route is the question, not production.
source: Reuters via Yahoo 2026-11-25 03:26Z; Al Jazeera 11/24 and liveblog headline 11/25; Xinhua 11/25 06:12 (22:12Z 11/24); JPost (Reuters) 11/24; The Nation Thailand 11/25; search summaries where named. Helper page reads; aninews, Statesman, Deccan Herald refused
